the thermal regeneration process is not a simple desorption process but is accompanied by degradation of the phenols.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the activated carbon can be regenerated by heating to 1100K in a flow of He.
the thermal regeneration of the activated carbon can be carried out without significant damage to the activated carbon.
